description: Search 960+ evidence-checked AI automation, internal-tools and AI-app agencies on Cofounderbase by a plain-English need. Optional filters: city, country, service, tool (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier, Retool, Vapi), max starting budget in USD and verified_only. Returns ranked agencies with a reason for each match, a Verified flag and a profile link. Ranking here is by fit and score only; the Verified boost applies in match_agencies.

budget.description: Max published starting price in USD

query.description: What the buyer needs, e.g. "AI voice agent for a dental clinic"

service.description: Service, use case or platform keyword, e.g. "voice agents"

tool.description: Platform the agency should build with, e.g. "n8n"

name: search_agencies
title: Search AI automation agencies
